description: Static descriptions of researches r1-r15 for notebooks/full_planner.ipynb. 'per_level_bonus_pct' is the bonus each level adds; the notebook derives its attack, shield, hull, energy and ship-speed multipliers from it (r1's bonus is applied inside game_data.mine_production_per_hour). 'cost_scale_factor' is the nominal cost ratio between consecutive levels of every research. 'name' must match spaceinvasion.core.game_data (checked when the notebook loads the file).

r1.name: Mining technology
r1.applies_to: b1 Pig iron, b3 Kryptonite, b4 Spice across all planets (NOT b2 Blast furnace)
r1.strategic_effect: +2%/lvl global Pig iron, Kryptonite & Spice mine output

r2.name: Energy technology
r2.applies_to: b5 Fusion plant, b6 Thermosolar plant, s9 Solar cells across all planets
r2.strategic_effect: +1%/lvl global energy output; gates b9, b6, r1, shields & turrets

r3.name: Engine research
r3.applies_to: Unlocks Rocket (L2), Diffusion (L6), and Warp (L8) drive trees
r3.strategic_effect: Core propulsion gate (L2 -> r4, L6 -> r5, L8 -> r6)

r4.name: Rocket engine
r4.applies_to: s1 Small transport, s2 Large transport, s4 Small fighter, s5 Warship, s8 Colony ship, s10 Spy probe

r5.name: Diffusion engine
r5.applies_to: s3 Transmitter, s6 Starcruiser, s7 Phoenix, s11 Recycler
r5.strategic_effect: +10%/lvl flight speed on Diffusion-engine fast-raid & recycler fleets

r6.name: Warp engine
r6.applies_to: s13 Battleship, s14 Stealth bomber, s15 Destroyer, s16 Imperial starbase
r6.strategic_effect: +10%/lvl flight speed on heavy Warp-engine capital wings

r7.name: Spy technology
r7.applies_to: s10 Spy probe intel depth, counter-espionage, s14 Stealth bomber late detection
r7.strategic_effect: Expands spy report tiers (fleets/defense/buildings/research) & Stealth concealment

r8.name: Weapons technology
r8.strategic_effect: +10%/lvl weapon attack power on all combat units

r9.name: Shield technology
r9.strategic_effect: +10%/lvl shield absorption capacity; gates Shield domes & r12

r10.name: Defense systems
r10.strategic_effect: +10%/lvl structural hull/armor points; gates s7 Phoenix (L5)

r11.name: Targeting systems
r11.applies_to: Ion, Heavy graviton, Positron, Interval, Laser, and Solar cannons

r12.name: Particle analyzer
r12.applies_to: b16 Particle shield (L2), d6 Interval cannon (L4), b15 Particle cannon (L5)
r12.strategic_effect: Gates planetary Particle shield, Interval cannon & Particle cannon

r13.name: Graviton technology
r13.applies_to: Light/Heavy graviton cannons & r15 Black hole research (L10)
r13.strategic_effect: Unlocks Graviton turrets & gates Black hole research

r14.name: Teleportation
r14.applies_to: b18 Teleporter (unlocked at L6) cooldown & energy efficiency
r14.strategic_effect: Unlocks b18 Teleporter (L6) & reduces jump cooldown/energy

r15.name: Black hole research
r15.applies_to: s16 Imperial starbase unlock (L2) & system scanner-blindness (4h + 1h * L)
r15.strategic_effect: Unlocks s16 Imperial starbase (L2) & extends scanner jam to (4 + L) hours
